g.text: DTB CRYSTALLIZER VER 1 - OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
AMMONIUM SULPHATE DTB VACUUM CRYSTALLIZER CR-201
1. Flows in t/h; temperatures in deg C; pressure in kPa abs. Design values from the OTS model.
2. Stream numbers are this drawing's own; the BFD number is given in the PFD tab.
3. Only the control valves that define the process are shown; the rest are on the P&ID.
